title: Chapter 15
text: What no one openly says is that while all four quadrants obey the Code of Conduct, a rider’s first responsibility is to the Codex, which often overrules the regulations other quadrants live by. By definition: the riders make their own rules. —M AJOR A FENDRA’S G UIDE TO THE R IDERS Q UADRANT (U NAUTHORIZED E DITION )
